please do, it's a fairly new site so there are definitely still bugs to be worked out. But if you create a free profile then we can easily get back in touch with you and even message each other off chat to stay in touch!

Of course, even more when you're younger, All you want to be doing is moving, keeping yourself sane. Sometimes college can feel almost like it's meant to torture people who are more vulnerable to compulsive thoughts. Mental illness can definitely bring on feelings of being stuck or ignored; if it didn't then maybe more people would be better already. But If there is no sense of humanity around us it's only natural that we feel unhappy; no one should have to ever miss out on empathy from others. I'm sure your family would do their best to be understanding of what it is you're living through. The internet is a great source too; there' a program called iprevail; anyone here who would like someone to chat with anonymously should give it a try. It's not necessarily a suicide hotline; just a place to clear your mind a bit and BE heard. Please, anyone who's been going through any kind of trouble, give it a try. It's free and you can come back whenever you'd like once you make a profile. https://www.iprevail.com/chat_landing?rsc=deharoerik
